title: Page Curve and Islands
description: The radiation's entropy rises as a black hole evaporates, then - after the Page time - falls back to zero: the information comes out. Islands inside the horizon, counted as part of the radiation, make it turn over.

puzzle.goal: A black hole takes a time τ to evaporate from mass M to nothing, its remaining lifetime going as the cube of its mass. Write the time t it takes to shrink from M to m.
puzzle.name: Page time
puzzle.ask: Find t in billions of years for T = @{T}, M = @{M} and m = 0.7071 (half the entropy gone: m = M/√2).
puzzle.method: The time left goes as M³, so the time taken to fall to m is τ − τ(m/M)³. Entropy goes as M², so half is gone at m = M/√2.
